text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait has stakes in 19 development projects in Egypt, official says.
- Kuwait in favour of creating a United Nations rapid deployment force to support the U.N. Iraq-Kuwait Observation Mission which monitors the border with Iraq.
- Emir Sheikh Jaber to patronise Kuwait University's 30th anniverssary celebration.
- Pakistanis in Kuwait send home $100 million a year.
- Price index of Kuwait Stock exchange rises on Tuesday.
- Iraq must provide information on its lethal arms-Britain.
